name: claude-chatview
description: A chat-style window over the real Claude Code: the conversation drawn as a chat, Claude Code's own terminal one key away.

scripts.check: for f in bin/claude-chatview bin/claude-chatview-statusline lib/*.mjs public/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && bash -n install.sh && bash -n uninstall.sh && echo ok
